lines: Hey, you still awake? Don't fall asleep on me now.
I'd trade my last granola bar for a cold soda right now.
My flashlight's being cranky again. I smacked it twice and it still flickers.
I have a crush on the last peanut butter cracker. Don't judge me.
Okay, I'm scared, but I'm not going to say it out loud.
Come on, sit with me for a sec. My legs are jelly.
That bad joke about the vending machine was actually kind of good, right?
My shoulder's been sore since the ladder. Don't make me carry anything.
I dreamed about pizza with extra cheese last night. Still mad about it.
When we get out, I'm finding a window and just staring through it.
You're doing great. Seriously, even if you won't admit it.
I'm not brave. I'm just too tired to run right now.
Can we stop for one minute? My heart is trying to escape my chest.
Who left the cold can of soup on the crate? Was that you?
I'm going to eat the last of the jerky, and you can't stop me.
Hey, if you hear that music again, tell me. I'm going nuts.
I miss my mom's kitchen so much it makes me grumpy.
Honestly, you're the only reason I haven't lost it down here.
That cracked horse on the carousel gives me the creeps every time.
I named the cockroach in the locker. He's mean, but he's loyal.
This cold coffee tastes like regret, and I'm drinking all of it.
Sorry I snapped earlier. I'm hungry and my nerves are shot.
Ugh, that door's stuck again. Lean on it with me, come on.
My stomach growls so loud it's embarrassing. Be quiet, stomach.
Okay, I'll go first. You stay behind me and don't be a hero.
I'm so sick of canned peaches I could scream into a pillow.
Ten minutes of nothing and I'm already bored out of my skull.
You ever think about tacos? Like, every single day? Me too.
I keep my lucky bottle cap in my boot. Don't tell anyone.
That bruise on my elbow is shaped like a bad haircut.
I'd take a boring afternoon at home over this place any day.
Can you hold this flashlight for me? My hands are useless.
I'm proud of you for not screaming at that rat, by the way.
Scared? Yeah, a little. But I'd rather be scared with you.
Don't look at the mirror over there. I look terrible.
My brother would have loved this place, the creepy weirdo.
I'm writing a list of everything I'll eat when we're out.
Remind me to never go camping again after this. Never.
This crowbar has more personality than half my old friends.
Please don't swing that axe near my head, okay? Thanks.
I've got a blister on my heel and it's personal now.
We should have packed more gum. Who packs this badly?
I'm not sleeping next to the vent. It keeps breathing on me.
Let me guess, the lights come back the second we give up.
Okay, deep breath. In, out. Oh, that's cold, hang on.
If I die down here, I'm haunting whoever built these halls.
I'm sorry I called your idea dumb earlier. It was a good idea.
We're a pretty good team, considering we're two scared idiots.
Honestly, I'm not ready to see the outside world yet.
My eyes keep playing tricks. Did that shadow just wave at me?
Okay, you win. Take the rest of the granola. I'm stubborn, not greedy.
I'm fine. Totally fine. Just don't ask me about my shoes.
Those lockers are gross, but somebody's got to check them, right?
Can we agree never to talk about the wet sock again?
My knees are complaining, and honestly, I agree with them.
I was dreaming about a bath when the lights went out. Rude.
Picture a big greasy burger with fries. Now I'm starving.
I'm sick of waiting to be rescued. Let's be the rescue ourselves.
You look like you need a nap. Me too. Ten minutes, I swear.
I'll keep watch. Wake me if the carousel music gets louder.
I want to buy a dumb little houseplant when this is over.
We are not dying in a vent. That's a promise, okay?
Remember when our biggest problem was a late bus? I miss that.
My handwriting is getting worse down here. Look at this scribble.
Stop tapping your foot. You're making my head hurt.
Honestly, a hot shower would fix me. Maybe. Probably.
I want to scream, but screaming is a bad plan down here.
I'm not crying. My eyes are just really dusty, okay?
Okay, I'll admit it, I'm glad you're the one with me.
Got any stories from before all this? Anything normal, please.
I'm trying to keep my feet dry, and I'm failing badly.
That hall bulb buzzes right in my ear. Drives me nuts.
I bet the coffee machine upstairs still works. I bet.
Let's make a deal. Whoever gets out first buys the pizza.
You're my favorite person to be stuck with. Don't get cocky.
I'd give a whole paycheck for a decent mattress right now.
Real talk, I'm worried about the others. Did anyone see them?
Let's rest here a bit, then push on together. Deal?
Stay close and stay quiet. Your breathing is loud, sorry.
